card.name: Striking with an implement or weapon
card.fires_on: The word 'with' (or a nearby linking word) right after a striking verb like hacked, beaten or whipping, where a tool or weapon comes next. Also 'swing' and 'sword' in violent or tool-use passages.

modes.label: With after striking verb
modes.description: The word 'with' after a verb of hitting or cutting, just before the instrument is named.
modes.example: hacked<< with>> machetes, shot and decap

modes.label: Swinging a weapon
modes.description: The verb 'swing' or a sword image in a fight scene.
modes.example: grabbed his Bowie knife and began to<< swing>> furiously at the Union soldiers.

modes.label: Choosing a tool to press or spread
modes.description: Linking words before a hand tool used on a surface, such as a spatula or spoon.
modes.example: a flat-surfaced tool such as<< a>> metal spatula or tongue depressor.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward swing and stroke words, as if a swinging or striking action comes next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about hitting or cutting with a tool or weapon and the next word is likely a swinging action.
